assets.caption: The scene is a functional, older adult-friendly bathroom captured in a realistic style, conveying a sense of practicality and routine. The overall tone is unpretentious and lived-in, reflecting daily use and accessibility considerations. The bathroom continues to the left, revealing a simple wooden vanity with a single sink and a mirror above it, providing space for personal care items. To the right of the existing toilet, the beige tiled floor extends, leading to a closed wooden door that serves as the entrance to the bathroom. The walls throughout the room are painted a light, neutral color, maintaining a consistent aesthetic with the visible areas. The ceiling is plain and white, featuring a single, functional light fixture providing general illumination to the entire space. The shower-tub combination, equipped with grab bars and a shower chair, maintains its central role as a key feature of the bathroom, with a loose crumpled bath mat draped over its edge. The toilet with its safety frame is situated adjacent to the tub, facing the vanity. The 360 scene is faultless.
